# Lockup

The mark and the wordmark set together.

## Anatomy

A `FlameMark`, then the product name in the display italic at the given size and tracking.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` *(required)* | `string` | — | The wordmark. A product name is not a translatable string, so it is passed in, not built in. |
| `markSize` | `number` | — | — |
| `fontSize` | `number` | — | — |
| `tracking` | `number` | — | Tracking in px. The reference varies it with the wordmark's size. |

## Variants

Size and tracking vary with where it is used.

## States

Static.

## Tokens consumed

| Token | Resolves to |
| --- | --- |
| `--text-primary` | `#1c1a16 / #ede6d6` |
| `--type-heading-family` | `"Cormorant Garamond", Georgia, serif` |
| `--type-heading-weight` | `500` |
| `--type-numeral-leading` | `1` |
| `--ui-stack` | `8px` |

Every value resolves through a semantic or component token; `scripts/check-fidelity.mjs` fails on a literal.

## Keyboard

Not interactive.

## ARIA

The wordmark is real text, so it is announced without help and the mark beside it stays decorative.

## Accessibility acceptance criteria

- Reachable, operable and leavable by keyboard alone, with a focus indicator meeting 3:1 in both schemes.
- An accessible name for every control, and current state exposed programmatically.
- No meaning carried by colour alone.
- Legible and operable at a 360px viewport and at desktop width, and at 200% zoom.
- Interactive targets at least 44 × 44px on touch-capable viewports.
